name: note-jukebox-activate
comment: WP-1.8 BlockNote and BlockJukeBox under use_item with an empty hand. The note block (25) on stone: BlockNote.blockActivated (TileEntityNote.changePitch, triggerNote: air above, rock below, playNoteAt -> BlockNote.playBlock, sound and particle only) returns true twice. The jukebox (84, metadata 0, no record): BlockJukeBox.blockActivated returns false, and with nothing held the click does nothing else. A note block with a block above (glass at t=0) still returns true but plays nothing. rng_state every tick: none of it draws.
